m.aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Skandamātā; your name comes fifth (among the nine Durgās). You know what is in every heart; you are the Mother of the world, the mother of all.
m.aarti.pad2: May I keep your flame burning; may I meditate on you always. You have been called by many names; I have one support, yours.
m.aarti.pad3: In some places your dwelling is on the mountains; in many cities you make your home. In every temple there are sights of you; your beloved devotees sing your virtues.
m.aarti.pad4: Grant me devotion to you; O Śakti, set right what has gone wrong for me. Indra and all the other gods together make their plea at your door.
m.aarti.pad5: When the wicked demons came marching on, you alone raised the sword in your hand. You came to save your servants always; you came to fulfil your devotee's hope.
